title: The Naimur Email OTP Verification for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to… (CVE-2026-104014)
description: The Naimur Email OTP Verification for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress versions up to 2.1.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to take over user accounts if the account owner previously requested and verified a password-reset code but did not complete the reset process. The vulnerability arises because the plugin authorizes password resets solely based on a database row marked as 'VERIFIED' without timestamp checks, session binding, or per-reset tokens. Additionally, a scheduled cleanup event intended to clear expired OTPs is never executed, leaving verified states lingering. Exploitation requires only the victim's email and a publicly localized nonce, enabling attackers to overwrite passwords and gain authenticated sessions, potentially leading to full site takeover for administrator accounts.
